_comment: Every photo on the site, with its credit and licence. Only images we own or are licensed to use. No scraped images, no photos of identifiable people. CC BY / CC BY-SA licences require the credit line, which the Photo component prints under each image. Resized derivatives of CC BY-SA photos are shared under the same licence. Unsplash photos may be added with licence 'Unsplash License' (credit kept here, not required on the page).
